text: Air is formless and possesses the quality of touch. It is of two kinds: eternal and non-eternal. The eternal is in the form of an atom; the non-eternal is in the form of an effect. Furthermore, it is threefold based on the distinction between body, sense organ, and object. The body is in the realm of air. The sense organ is the skin, which perceives touch and pervades the entire body. The object is that which causes the shaking of trees and other such things.
